open_questions: Walter Hawkins' Love Alive (1975) is named only in a reader comment; find his drum credit.

identity.name: Joel Smith
identity.summary: Oakland gospel drummer and bassist, nephew of Edwin and Walter Hawkins, on the Hawkins records of the 1970s; died 2018.

contribution.description: A drummer of the Hawkins family records whom the gospel-chops generation names as a source: Thomas Pridgen calls him a gospel pioneer, and Robert Searight his biggest early influence.
